integrity: The claim is derived from the published sharp-boundary formula and exact analytic series algebra. The accompanying verifier replays the rational coefficient identities; no numerical experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Local asymptotic statement at \(a=0\) only. It does not determine the interior branch transition, the \(a=2/e\) endpoint, or nonmonotone-delay behavior. At the critical scaling \(\kappa=1/3\), the cubic term alone is insufficient.
title: Cubic boundary layer at the classical limsup corner for second-order delay oscillation
